name: cli-tools
description: Profullstack's command-line tools as installable plugins — publish to the plain-HTML blog without getting a convention wrong.

plugins.name: blog
plugins.description: Write, check and publish posts on the plain-HTML blog: next post number, smolweb-valid template, index listing and feed regeneration, with a lint that catches the mistakes that silently break RSS.

plugins.name: domain
plugins.description: Find domains you can actually register, and look one up in depth. Availability is read from the registry over RDAP, never guessed from DNS, so parked names and registrations with no nameservers are not mistaken for free.
